name: 1min.AI
description: A multi-model platform with earned credits and a text-generation API.
overview: The provider documents 15,000 credits for visiting the web app each day; a separate provider article says signup credits can be spent on its Chat with AI API. Whether daily-earned credits can be spent through the API was not independently established. Credits are platform units, not tokens. The model names and access were not independently verified.
free_access: Free signup credits advertised for the chat API
API use of daily-earned credits unconfirmed
Default API limit: 180 requests/min per key
notes: Chat API https://api.1min.ai/api/chat-with-ai uses its own request format. Check the account credit rules before relying on daily API access.
